canonical_name: Center manifold theorem for reduction near a nonhyperbolic equilibrium
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no dynamical-system form, state space, equilibrium and solution model, linearization, center/stable/unstable spectral splitting, regularity, locality, graph and tangency conditions, invariance semantics, nonuniqueness policy, reduced equation, or conclusion strength. Carr's matching book contains multiple center-manifold results, but the accessible metadata and preview do not expose or select a complete numbered theorem. Choosing a familiar formulation would invent missing mathematics and may merge the distinct THM-P-0741 source record.
domain_and_universes: Open: the selected source must fix time and state spaces and universes, scalar field, finite-dimensional or Banach structure, vector field and domain, equilibrium, solution or flow carrier, linearization, and every center/stable/unstable subspace or spectral convention.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose existence and regularity of a local center manifold, local invariance, an induced reduced equation, trajectory tracking, stability transfer, approximation, uniqueness-as-germ, or a conjunction of these results.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: existence of a local center manifold tangent to a source-defined center subspace and represented as a graph
local invariance of that manifold for a source-defined flow or local ODE solution

tracking or local correspondence between sufficiently small full-system trajectories and reduced trajectories
transfer of stability or instability between the reduced equilibrium and the full equilibrium

degenerate_cases_to_resolve: zero-dimensional center, stable, unstable, or total state spaces
purely center spectrum and absence of a hyperbolic complement
nontrivial Jordan blocks on the imaginary axis
zero nonlinear term, constant dynamics, or nonisolated equilibria
zero-radius neighborhoods and trajectories leaving the local chart
forward-only versus two-sided local solutions and cutoff-dependent invariance
multiple center manifolds and equality only as germs or to finite order
parameter directions adjoined as zero eigenvalues
finite versus infinite differentiability and loss of regularity
vanishing leading terms in the reduced dynamics
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1345 Hartman-Grobman or THM-M-1346 stable-manifold theorems
THM-P-0741, the separate physics center-manifold record attributed to Kelley/Pugh
a center subspace, invariant linear submodule, generic invariant set, or ODE existence theorem alone
a structure that assumes the manifold, invariance, reduction, tracking, or stability conclusion as data
a scalar normal-form example, numerical phase portrait, or unchecked local approximation
a finite-dimensional, autonomous, center-stable, map, PDE, or parameter variant chosen without source selection
the catalog's untrusted verified label or the API probe as proof credit
